spans.s: एव॑रूप a. of such a form or kind.
एवंवि॑द् a. knowing (thus).
एवं˚विद्व॑स् a. knowing (thus).
एवंविध a. of such sort, such.
एवंवृत्त a. behaving thus.
एवंकर्मन् a. having (done) this deed.
एवंगुण a. having such qualities or virtues.
एवंगु˚णोपेत a. having such qualities or virtues.
एवंतर्किन् a. so thinking.
एवंदर्शिन् a. so seeing or judging.

एव॑म् adv. so, in this way (later than एव॑ q.v.), often
correl. to यथा. Refers to what precedes or follows. एवं कृत्वा for
this reason.

एवमादि a. this (these) and the like, similar (lit. whose
beginning is such).

एवंपूर्व a. preceded by this (lit. having such a
predecessor).
एवंप्रकार a. of such kind.
एवंप्राय a. the same.
एवंभूत a. (being) such.
एवया॑ a. going quickly, swift.
एव˚या॑वन् a. going quickly, swift.

एवया॑मरुत् exclamation pertaining in some way to the
Maruts.
ए॑वाष m. a cert. small animal.
